source_record.prompt: Make a bounded wardrobe edit to the supplied accepted historical illustration. Preserve every recognizable face, apparent age, eye color, gaze, expression, facial anatomy, natural body fullness, hand and finger positions, action, composition, room and light. Do not slim Emma, change pregnancy/postpartum appearance, or replace anyone with a new actor. The supplied master-derived face is identity evidence, not an instruction to copy one later outfit into every year. Change only the specified clothes and arranged hair; preserve hair color and hairline exactly. Clothing is a researched period-plausible interpretation, not a claim the named people personally owned these precise garments. Natural photographic cloth and folds, no fashion-magazine styling, modern fasteners or modern hat. No text or new scene props. Preserve original input; this replacement does not add a second original count. November1838, Emma34. Keep exact face, reading gaze, hands and letter. Replace copied blue dress with a muted burgundy late1830s day dress, fitted bodice without slimming her underlying natural build, full skirt with fullness chiefly from gathering, sleeves tapering toward wrists and modest pale collar. Keep the existing restrained shawl but harmonize its earthy colors. Same dark hair neatly pinned back, with short softly arranged side sections rather than identical long ringlets. No mourning-widow symbolism, bridal detail or pregnancy exaggeration; she is not being shown pregnant. No new accessories.
source_record.source_limits: Period garment categories/forms only; exact individual colors, cloth, hairstyle and possession not documented. Garment references do not authorize body measurement claims.

normalization: Final placement id mapped to exact prompt/final bytes; source decision preserved, no new broader concurrence.
